nina_sales: Heads up 1: large enterprise wants an air-gapped POC. They care about deliverable format, upgrade cadence, and minimizing privileged access. Can we propose a plan + cost delta?

omar_se: Quick topology check 1: single isolated site, no egress at all? Any approved transfer method?

nina_sales: single DC, no outbound. approved transfer methods: encrypted courier disk or FIPS USB.

rachael_ops: Operational constraints: no online pulls, no telemetry, and operator-only install window. We'll need offline bundles + a preflight verifier they can run locally.

diego_security: Security notes: require SBOM + signed manifest. Customer prefers to own root cert; otherwise we can sign with a hardware signer and provide audit logs. No persistent remote exec.

artifact-bot: build:2026-05-10T14:02Z artifact-id: ai-bundle-20260510 sha256:feedface... sbom: included

omar_se: packaging suggestion: deliver initial full bundle (signed tar.gz) + delta minibundles for subsequent updates. Verification uses embedded root.pem. Provide manifest.json with: version, sha256, size, sbom_ref, signer.

rachael_ops: cadence proposal: POC = 1 full + 2 deltas over 30 days. Prod recommendation: monthly deltas, quarterly full refreshs, emergency hotfixes on demand (signed attestation required).

diego_security: privileged access policy: no Redwood persistent accounts. For emergencies only: named engineer accounts, JIT time-limited creds, and session recording. Must be in SOW.

sue_legal: add to security questionnaire: "Do you require remote exec?" Answer: No for standard installs. Emergency remote exec allowed only under written SOW and explicit customer approval.

nina_sales: pricing question 1: how much extra for offline packaging? customer asked delta vs full cost.

omar_se: delta builds are cheaper to produce but require additional validation steps. Estimate: POC SE hours: 24h (config + tests). Ops packaging fee: flat $2,800 for initial setup + $500 per delta run (packaging + signing).

rachael_ops: shipping options & rough ops time: sealed courier disk (10h ops + courier), encrypted USB prep (6h ops), offline registry tarball (12h ops + import guide). We'll include pass-through courier costs in SOW.

omar_se: runbook essentials: preflight verifier script, install steps, manifest verification snippet:
```
# on approved jumpbox
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify root.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz
jq -e .manifest bundle.json >/dev/null
```

diego_security: rollback plan: keep last two signed bundles on the site. No automated rollback. Rollback requires operator approval and signed change record.

sue_legal: liability note: physical shipment loss default = customer responsibility unless Redwood contracts courier. We'll add explicit language.

nina_sales: actionable ask: can we produce an internal deliverable (sample signed bundle, manifest, preflight script, estimated hours + pricing, and security wording) by EOD tomorrow? I need to send to the customer before Friday call.

omar_se: I can produce sample bundle + manifest. rachael_ops will do preflight scripts and ops estimate. diego_security will draft key mgmt text.

rachael_ops: I'll also include acceptance criteria: 1) bundle installed on isolated cluster, 2) baseline throughput test within SLA, 3) manifest & SBOM validated locally, 4) rollback tested.

diego_security: blocker: if they insist on customer-side signing we need a 2h onboarding to exchange root certs and verify locally. Flagging for schedule.

nina_sales: noted. I'll confirm whether they want to own signing. Thank you everyone 1 :thumbsup:
